answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade: each identity locks collateral that is slashed for cheating, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real money. A sybil flood may look as vast as an ocean, but every copy drains the attacker's funds. Reputation then builds only through honest completed work, so fresh clones start untrusted — like water seeping through karst, only proven agents reach the umber depths where high-value deals happen.
